verdict: Organic presence stays active, but action volume stepped down this week.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all 3,824 customer actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — came entirely through your organic Google Business Profile listings, with no paid advertising running. The notable development this week is a 44% drop in GBP actions over the last 7 days compared to the 7 days before, which points to a decline in organic search visibility rather than any ad-side issue. Two days at the end of the period (Oct 24–25) show zeros in the data, which appears to be a reporting gap rather than a true drop-off, and that is being confirmed now. To address the broader step-down in activity, we are reviewing both profiles for optimization opportunities — particularly the Fishers listing, where impressions are strong but the call rate is notably lower than Canton's.

highlights.phrase: total customer actions from your Google Business Profiles in the last 28 days
calls received across both Canton and Fishers locations this period
drop in GBP actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days

watch_item.issue: GBP action volume has stepped down from the 150–230 daily range seen earlier in the period, with Fishers converting impressions to calls at roughly half the rate of Canton.
watch_item.fix: Both profiles are being reviewed for listing optimizations to recover visibility and improve the Fishers call rate.
